headline: Wichita County Home Backup Report
summary: Homes in Wichita County face a long outage about once every 10 years based on 8 years of records since 2018. In February 2021, 16% of homes in the county lost power. The longest-waiting tenth faced about 62 hours for the longest-waiting tenth. In August 2023, 12% of homes in the county lost power. The longest-waiting tenth faced about 46 hours for the longest-waiting tenth. One Core lasts about 13 hours on one Core in January. One Core lasts about 32 hours on one Core in November. Two Cores last about 27 hours on two Cores in January. Two Cores cover 88% of past 12-hour-plus outage hours. Base confirms sizing at install.
